subject: Weekend concurrency buffer — Atlas Retail POC
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Nicole Price <nicole.price@atlasretail.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Weekend concurrency buffer — Atlas Retail POC

Hi Nicole,

Quick note ahead of your weekend ramp (May 29–30) for the checkout-LLM proof of concept. The team expects a concentrated soak to validate latency at peak checkout traffic: target throughput ~180 QPS sustained for 6 hours, with spikes to ~300 QPS for short bursts. We estimate token consumption of ~280k tokens/day during the run.

Can Redwood provision a temporary concurrency headroom and a small credit top-up to cover the spike window? Attached: poc-test-plan.pdf and usage-estimate.xlsx.

Proposed ask:
- Time window: 2027-05-29 00:00 UTC -> 2027-05-30 23:59 UTC
- Concurrency buffer: +150 QPS (burstable up to +300 QPS)
- Credit top-up: +300k token-equivalent allocation for the two-day test

If you confirm, I'll route an internal approval and share a short addendum for signatures. Also linking our mutual action plan: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-4932

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment(s): poc-test-plan.pdf (application/pdf), usage-estimate.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Nicole Price <nicole.price@atlasretail.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@atlasretail.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Weekend concurrency buffer — Atlas Retail POC

Thanks Priyom — appreciate the heads-up.

A few quick clarifications before we proceed:
- Is the credit top-up priced as a promo (no invoice) or will it be applied against our trial balance (we're still in trial)?
- Can Redwood guarantee that cached prefixes won't be flushed during the run? Low-p99 latency is our primary goal.
- We'll need a brief addendum to the trial T&Cs that limits the credit to test artifacts only (no production usage). Can you share a redline?

Billing contact here is accounts-payable@atlasretail.com. I'll loop in procurement if we need signatures.

If you can confirm the exact throughput goal in requests/sec and the estimated token count per request (you estimated total tokens, but procurement needs per-request numbers), that would help.

Nicole Price
Head of Engineering Programs
Atlas Retail
nicole.price@atlasretail.com

Attachment(s): signed-sow.pdf (application/pdf)

From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Nicole Price <nicole.price@atlasretail.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekend concurrency buffer — Atlas Retail POC

Hi all —

Thanks for the details, Nicole. Priyom, confirmed numbers look reasonable.

We can provision a temporary buffer with these constraints:
- Time window: 2027-05-29 00:00 UTC — 2027-05-30 23:59 UTC
- Headroom: +150 QPS guaranteed, burst up to +300 QPS for 5m windows
- Credit: one-time promo credit equivalent to 300,000 tokens, valid only for the POC window
- Caching: We'll pin prefix cache for the test routes to avoid eviction during the window

Marissa — requesting approval to attach the promo credit and emit a voucher code to Atlas's billing contact. If approved, I can prepare the addendum redline for Nicole and route DocuSign.

Nicole — I'll also attach a short "operational runbook" note to the test plan so your SREs know what to expect.

- Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Attachment(s): operational-runbook.txt (text/plain)
